---
name: Instrument proposal
about: Propose a measurement or source for Sensor Atlas
---

## Measurement

What physical question should someone be able to answer? Give an example result with units.

## Source and reference

Describe the sensor, source clock and sample format. Link the protocol or sensor documentation. Include a shareable trace or a model with an independently calculated result.

## Acceptance

Describe the shortest experiment that would verify the result in capture and replay. Identify the SDK, app or guide involved and any hardware needed.
